target_customer: Small and medium businesses buying and managing SaaS tools
problem: Companies juggle many SaaS logins, invoices and user accounts.
business_model: App store for business software with one login and invoice, reseller commissions presumed

founders.name: Gordian Braun
founders.background_notes: Listed as liquidator in German register data.

exit.reason: Liquidation per Startbase German register data

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating SaaS storefronts, billing and SSO is integration and partnership work.

defensibility.rationale: Single login and invoice create some lock in, but vendors can sell direct.

market_need_then: SaaS sprawl made SaaS management a funded category in 2018 to 2019.

branding.domain_note: onetool.co; an unrelated ONETOOL trademark exists in the US.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name with an unrelated trademark; no brand coverage found.

outcome_analysis: onetool was a Berlin app store for SaaS that raised an undisclosed seed backed by High-Tech Gruenderfonds in August 2020 and, per Startbase, was liquidated in 2021 after bringing in the MySoftwareScout business. No founder statement or press explains why, so the cause is not public. It competed with funded SaaS management firms.
notes: Seed amount undisclosed by Altair; Latka says $1.7M pre-seed July 2020 and a podcast says over 1.6 million euros, both single sources, unverified. Shutdown rests on Startbase and Nordic9 (bankruptcy), not press. onetool.co returned 403. Competitors were found by search, not named by onetool, with sources dated 2018 and 2019. Founder backgrounds not found.
